channel.description: Latest articles from Marin Independent Journal (marinij.com)

item.title: Texas man was fatally shot by a federal immigration agent last year during a stop, new records show
item.description: The death of 23-year-old Ruben Ray Martinez occurred in March on South Padre Island.

item.title: Trump administration to stand by tough Biden-era mandates to replace lead pipes
item.description: There are millions of lead pipes serving homes, mostly in older industrial cities.

item.title: Trump seethes over Supreme Court justices who opposed him on tariffs, especially those he appointed
item.description: Legal opposition to the tariffs crossed political lines.

item.title: Justice Department swiftly fires lawyer chosen as top federal prosecutor for Virginia office
item.description: James Hundley was fired via social media Friday shortly after he was chosen by judges.

item.title: Macklin Celebrini chases Olympic gold, and Sharks history, in game vs. U.S.
item.description: Canada faces the United States in men's hockey gold medal game at Milan Cortina Olympics

item.title: Marin avalanche victims mourned as recovery slows
item.description: The Marin County women killed in a Sierra avalanche this week remained on the mountain Friday as recovery teams waited for crews to make the area safer to work.

item.title: MCE board approves rate cuts starting in April
item.description: The action will reduce the agency's portion of monthly electricity charges for typical households by $11 a month.

item.title: Sports briefs: Handful of local wrestlers move into section semifinals
item.description: Novato High heavyweight Braeden Carroll pinned his opponent from Napa in Friday’s boys wrestling quarterfinals to reach the semifinals of the North Coast Section Championships at James Logan High in Union City, which continue Saturday.

item.title: Girls soccer: Marin Catholic uses set-piece superiority, advances to semifinals
item.description: The Marin Catholic girls soccer team sent a warning to any other teams that face them during the remainder of the postseason – concede free kicks around the 18-yard box at your own peril.

item.title: Girls basketball: Redwood rolls into D-I semifinals
item.description: Being the No. 1 seed in the North Coast Section Division I girls basketball tournament has its privileges and could very well give Redwood High the upper hand in its quest for a second championship in three seasons.
